name: overwatch-monorepo
description: Overwatch — NSE trading assistant. Monorepo: core doctrine library + CLI (+ server/worker/web).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @overwatch/core && npm run build -w @overwatch/cli
scripts.build:backends: npm run build -w @overwatch/core && npm run build -w @overwatch/server && npm run build -w @overwatch/worker
scripts.dev: npm run build:backends && concurrently -k -n server,worker,web -c green,yellow,cyan "npm start -w @overwatch/server" "npm start -w @overwatch/worker" "npm run dev -w @overwatch/web"
